name: three-eras
description: Three Eras: a turn-based team battler in a single HTML file.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:offline && npm run build:app
scripts.check:dupes: grep -ohE "^(async )?function [A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*|^(const|let) [A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*" data.js engine.js art.js ui*.js | awk '{print $NF}' | sort | uniq -d
